Case No.: Azusa Walks Pedestrian Master Plan Location: Citywide
Applicant: City of Azusa
The City of Azusa has prepared the City’s first Pedestrian Master Plan which prioritizes pedestrian safety improvements to create a more walkable Azusa. The Plan aims to make walking in Azusa safer, more comfortable, convenient and accessible for pedestrians of all ages and abilities. The Plan includes proposed pedestrian infrastructure recommendations at priority locations.
This project is statutorily exempt from California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) review pursuant to Section 15262 – Feasibility and Planning Studies of the California Code of Regulations.
